ana-security: FYI: anomaly detected on internal SSH CA (ca-ssh-01). ~100 certs signed in ~12 minutes from an unexpected origin. Treat as suspected CA compromise. Follow emergency runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-incident
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Trigger: ca-signature-rate-detector (evt-id ca-2310001111). Baseline 0.8/min, observed 8.3/min. IDS alerted.
lena-sre: Oncall. Confirmed burst in CA audit log and pod stdout. Recommend immediate pause of signing endpoint and start key rotation in HSM.
mike-eng: Which services consume these certs? Trying to scope blast radius (bastion, deploy-runners, infra-hosts, kube-ssh-proxy, ci-workers?).
ana-security: (correction) ana-security: I'll coordinate details.
nana-security: High-level containment steps we should run now:
1) Disable CA signing endpoint (prevent new certs).
2) Snapshot & export issued serial numbers from audit log.
3) Publish temporary CRL and set clients to poll more frequently.
4) Create new HSM key, update CA metadata, and perform controlled re-issue with short TTLs.
5) Mass-revoke affected leaf certs and validate host access.

lena-sre: Stopping signing service now. Scheduling a 45m maintenance window starting in ~10m. Expect some internal SSH disruptions. Emergency jumpbox: jump-emergency-1 available.

mike-eng: Quick commands to gather evidence:
```bash
# stop service and extract issued serials
systemctl stop ssh-ca || pkill -f ssh-ca
journalctl -u ssh-ca.service --since "-30m" | grep "issued cert" > /tmp/ca_issued_30m.log
grep -o "serial=[0-9a-fA-F]\+" /var/log/ssh-ca/audit.log | sed 's/serial=//' | sort -u > /tmp/issued_serials.txt
```

prateek-devex: I'll prepare an Ansible play to revoke and reissue certs. Plan: canary (5 hosts) -> 25% -> 100% with manual approval gates. Uploading draft: https://git.redwood/internal/playbooks/ssh/rotate-ca-draft.yml

ana-security: Revocation example (use REVOC_TOKEN from vault):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REVOC_TOKEN" \
  https://ssh-ca-api.internal/api/v1/revoke \
  -d '{"serials": ["..."], "reason": "suspected_ca_compromise"}'
```
We'll also publish a signed CRL to s3://redwood-ssh-crl/incident-2310 and increase client CRL fetch frequency to 60s.

lena-sre: Coordinating with infra to block deployments that require new cert issuance. Updating CI runner cert pins.

mike-eng: HSM rotation questions: who can perform key creation? Need vendor support for key import/creation.

ana-security: HSM rotation plan (summary): create new key label ca-ssh-rot-2310, update CA public key in gitops, dual-sign for short overlap if necessary, then retire old key. Do not export private key.

sec-bot: Policy reminder: SEC-KEY-ROT-2 mandates legal & exec notification on confirmed private key compromise affecting customer-facing systems. Triage accordingly.

prateek-devex: Playbook ready in ticket TKT-INC-231000-SSHCA. Will request approval for full run in 15m.

lena-sre: Checklist (live):
- [x] stop signing service
- [x] export issued serials
- [x] publish temporary CRL to S3
- [ ] create new HSM key
- [ ] push CA metadata update to gitops
- [ ] revoke leaf certs via API
- [ ] automated reissue with short TTLs
- [ ] validate critical host connectivity + CI runners
- [ ] exec/legal notification if compromise confirmed

mike-eng: Notifying product and infra channels. Pausing pushes that depend on cert issuance.

ana-security: If we discover this was caused by a compromised automation token rather than HSM key theft, we'll still rotate metadata and revoke certs. Triage logs to determine origin (container user, CI job, or HSM).

lena-sre: HSM vendor on call and prepping key creation. Next update in ~20m.

sec-bot: All comms: use incident template and avoid posting raw serials or sensitive artifacts in public channels.

ana-security: Thanks everyone. We'll prepare an internal advisory and escalate to execs/legal if needed. Post-incident retrospective to be scheduled after containment. :lock:
